listing.name: Pokémon Sword (swsh-recomp)
listing.summary: Experimental AArch64 to C static host from LetsGo/LAS, Vulkan. Upstream maturity: Sword1.3.2 plus DLC on onePC; no full playthrough, memory growth,60fps experimental, title flicker; no online/trades/raids. Acquisition: Actual Windows ZIP imports/copies and locally recompiles, about40min on20threads; DLC not automated; no other desktop offer. Platforms: Windows10/11 x64 AVX2/FMA/BMI2, Vulkan1.3; RTX3080 only, AMD/Intel/iGPU untested. Original data: Own Pokémon Sword1.3.2 already-extracted updated exefs/romfs folders; optional matching owned DLC. XCI/NSP must be extracted externally first. No keys input is described in this launcher route; external extraction requirements are separate. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
